reviews.text: Excellent service, I recommend them 100%.

We've been taking our three Chihuahuas there since they were babies, and the doctors are wonderful. Thanks to the help of the entire clinic team, our dogs are healthy. We drive from Hollywood to Hialeah, but we're happy to go because we know our dogs are in good hands.

I am eternally grateful to the entire team at the veterinary clinic for caring for and saving my princess Susy 🐾❤️

Thank you for your love, dedication, and for bringing me peace of mind during such a difficult time. 🙏🏻
May God always bless your hands and the wonderful work you do. 🐶❤️

Benitez Animal Hospital. Thanks to them and their love for animals, my kitten Bella survived a botched procedure at another clinic. She arrived with an infected wound, and I was afraid they wouldn't treat her because she was coming from somewhere else, but quite the opposite happened. They welcomed her and cared for her with all the love and affection that a professional who loves their work and animals demonstrates. Thank you so much to everyone, and from now on, they will always be my pets' clinic.

⭐️ 1-Star Review

I am extremely disappointed with my recent experience at Benitez Animal Hospital. Unfortunately, I no longer feel that this hospital provides the same level of care it did years ago when Dr. Benitez was personally seeing patients. At that time, I considered this one of the best veterinary hospitals around.

I brought my dog in after she had experienced approximately a week of watery diarrhea. Other than the diarrhea, she was acting completely normal—she was eating, active, and behaving like herself. They performed blood work and fecal testing and told me that her liver enzymes were slightly elevated, but not significantly.

I was then presented with an approximately $3,800 estimate for hospitalization, with the recommendation that my dog be admitted and treated with IV medications because they believed she had pancreatitis and made the situation sound extremely serious and potentially life-threatening.

I did not feel comfortable proceeding with such an expensive treatment based on what I had been told, so I sought a second opinion from another veterinarian in the area. The second veterinarian performed additional testing, including specific blood testing for pancreatitis, along with other examinations. I was told that my dog did not have pancreatitis. Instead, the assessment was that she was experiencing colitis/stomach irritation, possibly related to a change in proteins or diet.

I am extremely grateful that I trusted my instincts and sought another opinion before agreeing to hospitalization and expensive IV treatment.

Unfortunately, this is not my first negative experience with this hospital.

When my dog was approximately seven months old, she injured her eye after hitting it against a wall. Her eye became completely white/cloudy. Benitez Animal Hospital prescribed several medications, including antibiotics, but her eye continued to get worse. I eventually took her to an eye specialist and learned that she had glaucoma caused by the injury, and I was told that the medications she had been receiving had contributed to increased pressure in the eye and made the situation worse.

After these two experiences, I can no longer recommend this hospital based on my personal experiences.

What is especially disappointing is that I remember Benitez Animal Hospital being a completely different place years ago. Dr. Benitez was wonderful, and I had a great deal of trust in him and his care. Unfortunately, my experiences with some of the newer doctors have been very different. I have also found some of the interactions with staff/doctors to be unnecessarily rude and dismissive.

I understand that veterinarians have to make difficult medical decisions and that pets can become seriously ill. I also understand that treatment recommendations and diagnoses can differ. However, when a pet is involved, owners deserve to feel that recommendations are being made based on careful medical evaluation—not that they are being pressured into extremely expensive treatment.

I am sharing my experience because I hope other pet owners will ask questions, request explanations, and consider getting a second opinion when something does not feel right, especially before agreeing to a very expensive treatment or hospitalization.

Benitez Animal Hospital is simply not the same place it was years ago, in my personal experience. I will not be returning.
They're pirates. Quado, the owner Benitez Stan died, charging almost 3-4 times more. Be careful.
They have great service!
The best clinic! They took great care of my dog ​​🐶 I recommend them 100% …

Good afternoon, I just left your clinic with my dog. The doctors provided good service, but the receptionist's response was inappropriate regarding an incident she caused through her negligence. When I politely explained what I saw, she was rude for not acknowledging her mistake (she knows what she did). I hope she reconsiders. "To err is human," she said. What a shame on our first visit. We left very disappointed. It was a bad decision to come to this place today.

Since I arrived in this country, I've been taking my dog ​​there, but these new people are the worst. Let me tell you: my dog ​​had seizures, so I have to be very careful with the medications I give him. I went to Benitez to ask what I could give him to prevent fleas and ticks. I explained the dog's condition, and they sold me Simparica. I asked, "Is it safe to give him this?" The guy assured me it was. I was in a hurry, so I just paid for the box and left. When I got home, I started researching, and surprise, surprise: Simparica is NOT recommended for dogs prone to seizures. I went back to the clinic to return it, and they took the box to show it to the doctor. They told me no because it was open and a pill was missing. I was shocked; the blister pack was open and had a black pen stain on it. I swear to God and a judge that I didn't open that box. It was my mistake because I should have checked it more carefully, but I was actually recording a vlog and you can see it when I look inside, even without removing the blister pack.

1- Who opens a blister pack with the tip of a pen?

2- I don't have black pens, only blue ones.

3- I would take those pills myself before giving them to my dog ​​and having them harm him.

4- It never crossed my mind that such a scam was possible because Dr. Benitez was a good person.

5- His excuse was: "We don't need to do that," well... apparently they do.

My solution was to go to another clinic, one of those old-school ones, with values ​​and warm care. I hope Dr. Benitez doesn't see what they're doing in his name.

THEY KILLED MY DOG - I am devastated to write this review, but I feel other pet owners deserve to be aware of my experience.

I brought my dog into this clinic for what was supposed to be a routine X-ray. Prior to this visit, my dog had been stable and was not in critical condition. Within a very short time of being taken to the back, I was informed that my dog had passed away.

This was extremely shocking, as I was not warned of any life-threatening risks associated with the procedure. I was also not allowed to be present, and everything happened very quickly with little explanation. As a pet owner, you trust veterinary professionals to communicate clearly and prioritize your animal’s safety and I do not feel that happened here.

I want to clarify something important for anyone reading these reviews. The animal hospital I took my dog to is now operating as Premium Animal Hospital, but the reviews are still listed under the name Benitez Animal Hospital.

Dr. Benitez, who was associated with the original practice, passed away approximately three years ago. I was informed of this through the court, and he is no longer alive or associated with the practice.

What concerns me is that the clinic continues to operate under the reputation and reviews associated with the Benitez name, while the current business is Premium Animal Hospital. The paperwork and filings I received also continued to use the previous business name, which made it very unclear to me as a client who was actually operating the hospital.

I originally chose this hospital because of the great reviews under the Benitez name, not knowing that the original owner had passed away and that a different business was now operating the clinic.

I believe this is important information for anyone considering bringing their pet here. Please make sure you know which business and veterinarian is currently providing the care, rather than relying solely on the older reviews associated with Benitez Animal Hospital.

I’m truly grateful to everyone at Benitez Animal Clinic for the wonderful care they gave my cat. From the moment we arrived, we were treated with so much love, compassion, and understanding. They also worked with me regarding my budget, which meant so much to me during such a stressful time.

A special thank you to Dr. Osvaldo and Antonio, who both assisted us and treated my cat with so much care and kindness. I truly appreciate the patience, compassion, and professionalism they showed.

I also want to recognize the young man at the front desk, who is always there and is incredibly kind, friendly, and helpful. He always makes an effort to give you the best attention and service possible, and that really makes a difference.

Thank you to the entire Benitez Animal Clinic team for caring for my cat as if he were your own and for treating me with kindness and respect. ❤️🐾

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for veterinarians and staff who genuinely care about animals and their families. Thank you for everything you did for us! 🙏❤️🐾

I want to sincerely thank the entire team at Benitez Animal Hospital for the excellent care they provided to Max, my Golden Retriever. We arrived very worried about his health, and from the very first moment, they treated us with kindness, professionalism, and care.

The staff took the time to explain what was happening and made us feel that Max was in good hands. It's clear they truly care about their patients and the peace of mind of their owners. Max had to stay hospitalized for more than 24 hours, and they called us to let us know how he was responding to treatment.

I am so grateful for the attention, care, and dedication we received. I wholeheartedly recommend Benitez Animal Hospital to anyone looking for a veterinary clinic where their pet will be treated with love and professionalism. ❤️🐾

• A Goodbye
A week ago we took our baby Justin to this clinic, where they received us as if we were providing care for humans. The care was warm, full of love and optimism, even though we knew his situation was very complicated and serious. Nevertheless, we are very grateful for all the love and support we received from the team, who did everything possible to improve his health, which inevitably led to the end we never wanted. For this reason, we will always be grateful for the care and trust they gave us.
Excellent service. Very professional and well-trained. Affordable prices. Parking is very difficult because it's always full, but it's worth waiting and someone will eventually free up a spot.

My granddaughter had a wonderful experience with Benitez Animal Hospital. The entire team was kind, compassionate, and truly cared about Andy (her cat) well-being. They took the time to answer all of her questions, explained everything clearly, and treated her cat with patience and gentleness throughout the visit.

I'm very grateful for the excellent care and professionalism they provided. It's reassuring to know her cat is in such caring and capable hands. I highly recommend Benitez Animal Hospital to anyone looking for a veterinary team that genuinely cares about their pets.

There are no words to describe the immense pain our family is feeling. Our hearts are completely broken.

My niece took her dog to this clinic because she knew something wasn't right. Instead of taking her concerns seriously, they told her it was probably just because she was in her period and sent her home with only vitamins. Blood test results showed extremely low white blood cell counts and virtually no platelets, and yet no further testing, hospitalization, or urgent referral for a more thorough evaluation was recommended.

Shortly after, our dog passed away. 😭

The hardest part of all is living with the question that will never be answered: What if…? What if they had investigated further? What if they had listened to my niece? What if they had given her the chance to receive timely treatment? We will never know, and that pain will stay with us for the rest of our lives.

Our pets depend entirely on veterinarians to be their voice when they can't express what they feel. We trusted this clinic to recognize the seriousness of the situation, and we feel that trust was betrayed.

This review doesn't stem from hatred, but from the immense pain and helplessness we feel. We hope our experience will serve as a warning so that, in the future, no veterinarian minimizes such worrying tests or ignores the anguish of an owner who knows their pet needs help.

While we were at this place waiting for the vet's report, we saw them hand a deceased dog to a young woman in a Walmart pet carrier. How awful!!

Our dog deserved every chance to fight for her life. We will always live with the doubt of whether those chances were denied her too soon. We hope no other family has to go through such devastating pain as ours 😭

One star is a must, but it's 0 stars. Stay away from this place!!!!!!
I really like the treatment I receive, from the doctor to the very professional staff. Everything is clean, and they explain everything in detail about your dog's situation. I'm very pleased.

I want to thank the team at Benítez Hospital for the excellent service they gave me today, from the moment I walked through the door until I took my dog ​​home with her puppy. I brought my dog ​​in while she was in labor, and honestly, if it weren't for them, she would have died. But thank God they performed a C-section, and everything was a success. Thank you so much to everyone.
Naylet, thank you for sharing your feedback. We appreciate you choosing Benitez Animal Hospital and are glad your experience was a positive one.
Mariana, thank you for visiting Benitez Animal Hospital and for sharing your feedback. We're glad to know you had a positive experience with us. Your kind words mean a lot to our team.
ATTENTION!!! Do not take your pet there, they gave me a bad diagnosis and almost operated on her for neutering purposes.

My dog ​​arrived at the hospital in very serious condition and was admitted. Every day they called me, morning and night, to tell me how he was doing and how his day had gone. The care from all the doctors and assistants was excellent. From the beginning, they told us what needed to be done and how they were going to treat him. Now my pet is home recovering and out of danger! Thank you for everything. I highly recommend the hospital.

I took my dog ​​in for an ear allergy. They told me he needed anesthesia and injections, which I never saw them give him. They didn't explain what was wrong with my dog; they just scraped his ear, and the hair hasn't grown back since. My dog ​​came out worse. They charged me an arm and a leg. I don't recommend this place for your pet, especially considering the number of bad reviews they have.
We are so grateful to this wonderful team of professionals for their patience and total dedication. Please continue this work. Thank you so much from the bottom of our hearts, Toby and Toby's family.
Thank you for sharing your positive feedback. We’re glad your experience with Benitez Animal Hospital was a good one. Your support means a lot to our team.

Thank you for sharing your feedback, Yadiel. We appreciate hearing from you and would love to know how we can make your next experience even better. If you have any suggestions or concerns, please let us know.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I want to sincerely thank the entire team at Benítez Animal Hospital. I took a kitten named Grizo, who lives in my building, because he hadn't been able to pee or poop for several days and was in very bad shape. Although he wasn't my cat, it broke my heart to see him suffering, and I decided to seek help for him.

When I arrived at the clinic, I explained the situation, and they were incredibly understanding and compassionate. They helped me immediately and, what's more, they charged me much less than the procedure normally cost, which I greatly appreciate.

It's clear that the people who work here truly love animals and have compassion for them. The treatment was professional, humane, and full of empathy. Thank you to each and every person who works there; everyone is a 10/10. I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality veterinary care and a team with a big heart. ❤️🐾
Thank you for your support, Laura. We appreciate you taking the time to leave a review for Benitez Animal Hospital.

Today I came to the clinic, and the service was wonderful, as always. The difference is that at this clinic, they actually help you get your pets cured. They truly care about their pets' health. I've been coming here for years, and the service has always been excellent. The only doctors who ever cured my Chihuahuas' skin conditions were here at Benítez. Honestly, family, come to this clinic. They're doctors, and they have a wonderful staff.

My dog ​​had a very severe allergy that greatly affected her skin, eyes, and ears. I went to every vet in Broward County, and they just took my money and didn't cure her. Every month they gave her a different injection and treatment, and she didn't get any better. When I went to Benitez Animal Hospital, they knew what was wrong with her from the moment they saw her and gave her the right treatment, which has cured her completely. I am so grateful 🙏

Excellent experience. I'm a first-time mom to a beautiful puppy and I felt very calm and well taken care of from the very first moment. The whole team was very kind, professional, and careful with my princess. I recommend them 100% for any needs of your furry babies 💕 …
Many thanks to Benítez Animal, they are very professional and improved my pets' health for an excellent price.

Thank you, Duniel, for leaving us a 4-star review! We appreciate your feedback and are glad to hear you had a positive experience at Benitez Animal Hospital. If you have any suggestions on how we can make your next visit even better, please let us know. Your pet’s health and your satisfaction are very important to us!

“I used to have a fantastic experience at this veterinary clinic under the previous owner—he was incredibly kind, professional, and truly cared for the animals. Unfortunately, the new owner is a completely different story. He is arrogant, dismissive, and acts as if his word is absolute. My visit was a truly awful experience. I won’t be returning and can’t recommend it anymore.”

I want to take a moment to publicly thank Benitez Animal Hospital for the incredible care we received. 🙏🐾

My dog ​​had surgery at this clinic, and thank God, the operation was a complete success! But beyond the result (which is already excellent), what truly makes the difference is the compassion of the entire team.

From the very first moment, the staff treated us with impeccable kindness and professionalism. They made both my girlfriend and me feel calm, heard, and in good hands at all times. The doctors demonstrated a level of knowledge, care, and dedication that inspires great confidence, something so important when it comes to our animals, who are family.

The care was clear, patient, and honest. They explained the entire process step by step and were attentive to every detail, before, during, and after the surgery.

Definitely, top-quality service, with a team that works with heart. I recommend this clinic 100% to anyone who wants the best for their pet.

Thank you again for everything you did for our dog. 💙🐶
